name: @imgly/codesign-mcp
stderr:
codesign-mcp: missing subcommand.
Usage: codesign-mcp <stdio|system-prompt|diagnose>

Subcommands:
  stdio                       MCP server over stdin/stdout. Spawned by hosts
                              like Claude Desktop / Claude Code via their
                              `command` config.

  system-prompt [-o FILE]     Print the design context a session reads before
                              its first `edit` — the loop, design rules,
                              copy rules, judge and the API surface — as
                              one system prompt, for headless runs that cannot
                              afford the reference reads:
                                codesign-mcp system-prompt -o codesign.md
                                claude -p "<brief>" \
                                  --append-system-prompt-file codesign.md
                              `--replace` emits the `--system-prompt` form.
                              `system-prompt --help` for the details.

  diagnose                    Collect local diagnostics logs into a redacted
                              .zip you can send to IMG.LY. No network. The
                              same as `cdsn doctor --bundle`.

Sign in with the `login` / `logout` tools from inside a stdio session —
an account is only needed for AI generation.

Env:
  CESDK_LICENSE                  CE.SDK headless engine license for a source
                                 build; a published build runs only the license
                                 it bundles and ignores this. IMGLY_CESDK_LICENSE
                                 is accepted as an alias.
  CODESIGN_WORKSPACE             a folder to use as the workspace; CoDesign
                                 adds its files there
                                 (default: ~/.codesign/workspace).
  IMGLY_MAX_ENGINES              design engines allowed to run at once across
                                 every server on this machine (default: 4).
                                 Each is ~200-500 MB resident; raise it on a
                                 big machine, lower it on a small one.
  IMGLY_ENGINE_IDLE_TIMEOUT      seconds a server may sit unused before it
                                 releases its engine back to that pool
                                 (default: 300, 0 disables). The next design
                                 call restarts it — a few seconds — so lower
                                 this to share engines between more open
                                 sessions, raise it to avoid the restart.
  IMGLY_CESDK_ENGINE             engine flavor: wasm | native (default: native,
                                 falling back to wasm if it cannot start).
  IMGLY_DISABLE_VIEWER           on hides the browser viewer; designs are
                                 delivered as files (default: off).
  IMGLY_TELEMETRY                on | off — usage telemetry (default: on).
  IMGLY_ERROR_REPORTING          on | off — send error reports (crashes, failed
                                 tool calls) to IMG.LY (default: on).
  IMGLY_PLUGIN_TELEMETRY         on | off — set by the Claude plugin's "Send
                                 usage data" setting; off turns usage telemetry
                                 and error reports off (default: on).
  IMGLY_PLUGIN_ERROR_REPORTING   on | off — set by the Claude plugin's "Send
                                 error reports" setting; off turns error reports
                                 off (default: on).
  IMGLY_GATEWAY_API_KEY          AI gateway key; an alternative to signing in
                                 with the login tool.
